search_window.basis: Since completed_at of preceding GitHub-verified Food Line supplementary heartbeat; assess newly published or newly effective U.S. food-access disruptions, not all historical search hits.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary bounded recall watch only; production nationwide Food Line collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster affecting a community's only, sole, last or full-service grocery store
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences

observations: South Plains Food Bank Nov 9 local release (4:50 PM CST = 2:50 PM PST) announced planned Veterans Day and later holiday closures; not abrupt disruption, and published before this watch window.
Wisconsin FoodShare news page last revised Oct 16, 2026. Existing PIN reset, replacement-benefits and other notices are preexisting; no newly dated in-window change.
Virginia DSS alerts page opened, with no substantiated newly announced in-window food-assistance interruption.
Hawaii benefits updates page describes existing SNAP call-center and processing delays without in-window first publication.
California CDSS CalFresh page provides general benefit information and existing links, not in-window official service interruption.
Feeding America West Michigan mobile pantry schedule retains Dec 3 CANCELLED at Ishpeming, MI, but no stated cause or posting time; cannot establish a new weather/disaster-related cancellation.

Search results repeatedly surfaced historical 2025 shutdown-related SNAP interruption, prior Sept 2026 Spencer NY sole-grocer fire, older pantry closures, and October 2026 storm distribution cancellation.

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Routine scheduled 2026 holiday closures and distribution information; announced 2:50 PM PST, preceding the window; not abrupt service loss.
Dec 3, 2026 canceled mobile distribution, with neither storm/disaster cause nor time of cancellation ascertainable; already noted prior hour.
Sept 11, 2026 incident already recorded in previous watch; not in hourly window.
Nov 8, 2025 SNAP interruption, not a 2026 event.
Existing prior-dated benefit notices; not a new interruption.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Excluded donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine promotions, generic inflation coverage, old events, non-US incidents and previously seen items.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruptions verified within hourly window across 12 targeted searches and 6 accessible direct pages. USDA SNAP updates page inaccessible; therefore status DEGRADED despite useful independent coverage. No negative nationwide absence assertion.
